The relic bearer's mana condenses into a thin protective shroud, separating the body from an enemy strike. Its flow spreads through the folds of mana-weave and extinguishes the threat before it can touch flesh. As long as the bearer has enough mana, incoming damage dissolves into the protective shroud, consuming only part of their reserve.

When damage is taken, forms a barrier around the wearer that fully intercepts incoming damage and consumes %1$s mana for each point of prevented damage. If there is not enough mana for full absorption, the barrier weakens and lets the remaining damage through.
If the barrier triggers again within %3$s seconds after the previous activation, incoming damage is additionally reduced by %2$s%%, growing stronger during a continuous series of hits.
Part of the absorbed damage energy is converted into health restoration for the wearer equal to %4$s%% of the prevented damage.
Absorbed damage is redistributed among targets within a radius of %5$s blocks.
+1 experience point for each damage absorption.
+1 experience point for each target damaged by redistribution.
relics.description.flaming_bracer.descri: The heat within the ancient plates responds to the relic bearer's movements, bursting from the arm in flashes of magical flame. Fire erupts at the moment of impact, binds the struck target, and ignites directly beneath it, forcing the enemy to remain where the flames will do the most harm.
relics.description.flaming_bracer.abilit: Each attack has a %1$s%% chance to release a surge of magical flame: the target is paralyzed for %2$s seconds, losing the ability to move or act, and magical fire is created beneath it, dealing %3$s damage and setting it ablaze.
Grants the relic bearer complete immunity to damage from magical fire.
While the relic bearer is inside magical fire, they restore %4$s health every second.
Attacks against targets standing in magical fire deal %5$s%% more damage.
+1 experience point for each successful ability trigger.
+1 experience point for each second of healing in magical fire.
+1 experience point for each attack with bonus damage.
relics.description.quantum_bubble.descri: Space near the relic bearer condenses into fragile bubbles, snatching incoming projectiles from their path. Anything caught inside freezes in a motionless distortion and remains there until the shell is destroyed. Even at invisible speed, the projectile never reaches its target: the bubble holds it in a frozen instant, preventing its motion from completing.
relics.description.quantum_bubble.abilit: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring one charge every %2$s seconds. When an enemy projectile approaches the bearer, it is automatically captured in a bubble and consumes one charge.
Destroying a bubble releases a burst of energy that blinds all targets within %4$s blocks for %5$s seconds and causes them to lose sight of the relic bearer.
When a bubble is destroyed, intercepted projectiles are empowered and redirected toward their original owner.
If at least one bubble with a captured projectile exists within %3$s blocks of the bearer, any incoming damage is fully canceled, after which one of the bubbles pops.
+1 experience point for each captured projectile.
+1 experience point for each full negation of incoming damage.
relics.description.staff_of_the_spectral: The relic bearer briefly slips from the world's familiar layer, leaving the body as only an unsteady ghost of form. Whether stone, wood, or metal, an obstacle loses its density and lets the bearer pass through like a shadow through smoke.

When activated, puts the bearer into a spectral state and propels them forward in the direction they are looking, allowing them to pass freely through blocks. During movement, nearby blocks are temporarily replaced with a spectral form that does not obstruct travel. The ability consumes one charge for each second of active movement and ends when charges are depleted or movement stops. The staff stores up to %1$s charges and restores one charge every %3$s seconds.
While the ability is active, all entities within %2$s blocks become visible through obstacles.
If the ability ends in a location where the bearer cannot safely stand, they are automatically returned to the last safe position.
While the ability is active, the bearer gains the Immortality effect.
+1 experience point for each second in spectral form.
relics.description.archmage_glove.descri: A cast spell does not always vanish at once: part of its structure catches on the glove's threads and lingers within them for a brief moment. An instant later, the stored form folds back together, as if the spell had been cast once more.
relics.description.archmage_glove.abilit: Each cast spell has a %1$s%% chance to start a multicast chain, in which it is automatically repeated up to %2$s additional times. Repeat triggers occur sequentially after a short delay, fully reproducing the original spell effect, including its damage, targets, and behavior.
While a multicast chain is active and the next trigger is pending, incoming damage to the bearer is reduced by %3$s%%.
Each time multicast fails to trigger, increases the chance of the next trigger by %4$s%%. After a successful multicast trigger, the bonus resets.
Each additional multicast trigger has a %5$s%% chance to return %6$s%% of the spell's base cost as mana.
+1 experience point for each additional multicast trigger.
reliquified_ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph: Marks the spell for Archmage Glove activation.
ars_nouveau.spell.validation.exists.mult: Only one Multicast glyph can be used in a spell.
ars_nouveau.spell.validation.adding.mult: Only one Multicast glyph can be used in a spell.
ars_nouveau.spell.validation.exists.mult: The Multicast glyph can only be placed immediately after the spell form.
ars_nouveau.spell.validation.adding.mult: The Multicast glyph can only be placed immediately after the spell form.
relics.description.emblem_of_defense.des: The recorded spell remains within a defensive circuit until the relic bearer comes under attack. At the instant of danger, the runes release it on their own, directing magic at the attacker before the owner can even register the threat.
relics.description.emblem_of_defense.abi: Allows a spell to be recorded onto the relic through the scribe's table. The spell must begin with touch and contain no more than %1$s glyphs. When the relic bearer takes damage, has a %2$s%% chance to automatically activate the recorded spell, instantly applying it to the attacking target.
The ability trigger completely suppresses the damage that activated it.
After a successful ability trigger, reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer by %4$s%% for %3$s seconds.
With a %5$s%% chance, the recorded spell resonates and is reapplied up to %6$s times to other nearby targets within %7$s blocks.
+1 experience point for each successful recorded spell trigger.
+1 experience point for each full suppression of incoming damage.
relics.description.emblem_of_assault.des: The recorded spell remains within an offensive circuit until the relic bearer lands a precise strike. At the instant of impact, the runes release it on their own, directing magic into the struck target before the weapon swing can finish.
relics.description.emblem_of_assault.abi: Allows a spell to be recorded onto the relic through the scribe's table. The spell must begin with touch and contain no more than %1$s glyphs. When the relic bearer deals damage, has a %2$s%% chance to automatically activate the recorded spell, instantly applying it to the struck target.
Each ability trigger restores %3$s health to the relic bearer.
After the ability triggers, increases damage dealt by the relic bearer by %5$s%% for %4$s seconds.
With a %6$s%% chance, the recorded spell resonates and is reapplied up to %7$s times to other nearby targets within %8$s blocks.
+1 experience point for each successful recorded spell trigger.
+1 experience point for each point of health restored by an ability trigger.
+1 experience point for each target additionally hit by spell propagation.
Additional Damage Dealt Under Ability Effect
Additional Targets Hit by Spell Propagation
relics.description.mana_ring.description: The relic bearer's inner reserve expands, allowing them to hold more mana and regain lost power faster.
relics.description.mana_ring.ability.res: Increases the relic bearer's maximum mana by %1$s%%.
Increases the relic bearer's mana regeneration speed by %2$s%%.
When the relic bearer restores health, also restores %3$s mana for each point of health restored.

Allows spells to be used when mana is insufficient by borrowing the missing amount. The borrowed portion of the cost is increased by %4$s%% and is repaid at the same rate and under the same conditions as normal mana regeneration.
+1 experience point for each point of mana restored through healing.
+1 experience point for each point of mana borrowed.
relics.description.ring_of_thrift.descri: The relic bearer's arcane flow becomes steadier, losing less power with each cast spell. Part of the spent mana does not disperse without a trace, but lingers in the conductive circuit, waiting to return a few moments later.
relics.description.ring_of_thrift.abilit: Reduces the relic bearer's mana cost by %1$s%%.
%2$s%% of spent mana is returned after %3$s seconds.
Each consecutive spell cast increases the relic bearer's mana regeneration speed by %5$s%% for %4$s seconds per trigger. The effect stacks up to %6$s times.
When casting a spell, has a %7$s%% chance to consume no mana.
+1 experience point for each point of mana returned by delayed refund.
+1 experience point for each spell cast that maintained accelerated mana regeneration.
+1 experience point for each spell cast without consuming mana.
relics.description.emblem_of_devotion.de: The recorded spell remains within a stable circuit, gradually forming into orbital spheres around the relic bearer. They circle nearby, holding the magic placed within them until they collide with a target.
relics.description.emblem_of_devotion.ab: Allows a spell to be recorded onto the item through the scribe's table. The spell must begin with touch and contain no more than %1$s glyphs. Periodically, once every %2$s seconds, summons an orbital sphere carrying the recorded spell. The sphere orbits the bearer and applies the spell when it collides with a target. No more than %3$s spheres can exist at the same time.
Each sphere hit has a %4$s%% chance not to consume the sphere.
A spell trigger grants the bearer %5$s absorption points, stacking up to %6$s points.
With a %7$s%% chance, the spell resonates up to %8$s times onto nearby targets within %9$s blocks.
+1 experience point for each orbital sphere hit on a target.
+1 experience point for each sphere preservation trigger.
+1 experience point for each target additionally hit by propagation.
relics.description.architects_staff.desc: Between two marked points, temporary masonry of conjured blocks is formed. It does not last long, but it is sturdy enough to bear the relic bearer's steps and connect a broken path.
relics.description.architects_staff.abil: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring one charge every %2$s seconds. The maximum length of the created bridge is %3$s blocks. Holding RMB marks the first point, and releasing it marks the second, after which a bridge of conjured blocks is created between them for %4$s seconds. Each unit of bridge length consumes 1 charge.
While the relic bearer stands on the bridge, the effectiveness of incoming healing is increased by %5$s%%.
While the relic bearer stands on the bridge, their projectile damage is increased by %6$s%%.
While the relic bearer stands on the bridge, they gain the Vanishing effect. Any interaction with the world removes them from it for %7$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each successful bridge creation.
+1 experience point for each bridge block created.
Additional Projectile Damage Dealt on Bridge
relics.description.illusionists_mantle.d: An incoming strike splits into a false image, leaving a new target beside the attacker for doubt and error. Illusions draw attention away from the relic bearer's true body, disrupting enemies' choice of target. The more such reflections are nearby, the harder it becomes for an enemy strike to find the right direction.
relics.description.illusionists_mantle.a: When the relic bearer takes damage, has a %1$s%% chance to create an illusion behind the attacking target, lasting %2$s seconds.
Reduces damage taken by the relic bearer by %4$s%% for each of their illusions within %3$s blocks.
Destroying one of the relic bearer's illusions inflicts paralysis on its linked target for %5$s seconds.

When fatal damage is taken, transfers the relic bearer to their nearest illusion. A new illusion appears and immediately dies at the location where the damage was received, while the chosen illusion disappears.
+1 experience point for each illusion created.
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced by illusions.
+1 experience point for each paralysis trigger from a destroyed illusion.
+1 experience point for each death prevention by exchanging with an illusion.
relics.description.spiked_cloak.descript: A heavy blow awakens living spikes within the relic's fabric, sending them flying from the bearer in every direction. Each released shard digs into a target, wounding it and hindering its movement.
If damage taken by the relic bearer exceeds %1$s%% of their maximum health, has a %2$s%% chance to release up to %3$s spikes in different directions. Each spike deals %4$s damage and applies Slowness III for 5 seconds.
A spike hit applies bleeding level %5$s to the target for %6$s seconds.
Triggering the ability reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer by %7$s%% for %8$s seconds.
A spike hit has a %9$s%% chance to release up to %10$s additional spikes.
+1 experience point for each spike burst trigger.
+1 experience point for each spike hit.
+1 experience point for each additional spike trigger.
relics.description.ring_of_last_will.des: A fatal strike leaves a trace of a moment within the relic, one that can still be rewound. Instead of dying, the relic bearer returns a few seconds into the past, to a point where their body had not yet fallen.
relics.description.ring_of_last_will.abi: When fatal damage is taken, returns the relic bearer 3 seconds back in time. The ability goes on cooldown and can only trigger again after %4$s seconds.
The next attack against the target that dealt fatal damage deals %1$s%% more damage.
The target that dealt fatal damage is paralyzed for %2$s seconds.
After the ability triggers, the relic bearer gains the Immortality effect for %3$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each time rewind trigger.
+1 experience point for each empowered retaliatory attack.
+1 experience point for each successful paralysis of the target that dealt fatal damage.
Additional Damage Dealt by Retaliatory Attacks
Paralysis Time of Targets That Dealt Fatal Damage
relics.description.ring_of_last_will.syn: During the time rewind, leaves an illusion at the starting point that forces targets within %1$s blocks to attack only it, and grants the relic bearer the Vanishing effect for the entire rewind duration.
relics.description.wing_of_the_wild_stal: The air catches the relic bearer and lets them fly briefly like with elytra. The flight quickly turns into descent, but gives enough time to reposition, escape pursuit, or strike a target from above.
Allows flight like with elytra for no more than %1$s seconds, after which the relic bearer is forced into descent.
Reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer while flying by %2$s%%.
Attacks performed by the relic bearer while flying deal %3$s%% more damage.
Double-pressing the jump key while flying performs a swift dash forward with a force of %4$s. The ability cooldown is %5$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each second of flight.
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced while flying.
+1 experience point for each attack performed while flying.
+1 experience point for each dash while flying.
While flying with the wing, leaves a chain of lightning behind the relic bearer that lasts %1$s seconds and deals %2$s damage on contact.
The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
relics.description.whirling_broom.descri: The air beneath the broom's bristles condenses into a stable support, allowing the relic bearer to maneuver freely above the ground and stay airborne. Its height is limited, but sufficient to glide confidently over the surface, bypass obstacles, and maintain control.
relics.description.whirling_broom.abilit: When used, summons a broom and automatically seats the relic bearer on it. The broom moves at a speed of %1$s, cannot rise higher than %2$s blocks above the ground, has %3$s health, recovers %4$s seconds after being destroyed, and regenerates 1 health once every %5$s seconds.
While the relic bearer is riding the broom, incoming damage to them is reduced by %6$s%%.
While the relic bearer is riding the broom, any projectiles pass through them.
Holding the sprint key accelerates the broom by %7$s%% and consumes %8$s mana per second.
relics.description.whirling_broom.synerg: While flying on the broom, leaves a chain of lightning behind the relic bearer that lasts %9$s seconds and deals %10$s damage on contact.
The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
relics.description.ballistarian_bracer.d: As soon as a projectile leaves a bowstring, palm, or enchanted staff, an arcane trail follows it, giving birth to phantom copies. They follow the main shot and increase its power, turning a single projectile into a short spectral volley.
relics.description.ballistarian_bracer.a: When firing any projectile, has a %1$s%% chance to launch up to %2$s additional projectiles. Each trigger increases the main projectile's damage by %3$s.
Each kill with a projectile grants the relic bearer %4$s absorption points, up to a maximum of %5$s points.

Each projectile hit has a %6$s%% chance per phantom projectile to duplicate the dealt damage onto targets within %7$s blocks. The number of additional targets is up to the number of phantom projectiles.
A target hit by a projectile is stunned for %8$s seconds for each phantom projectile.
+1 experience point for each phantom projectile fired.
+1 experience point for each phantom damage trigger.
relics.description.horn_of_the_wild_hunt: The horn's drawn-out call spreads through the air and sets spectral wolves, bound to the relic bearer's will, on the trail. They appear near their master, leap at their enemies, and continue tearing into prey without fear or wounds.
Summons up to %1$s invulnerable wolves that fight on the relic bearer's side. Each wolf deals %2$s damage.
A target killed by a wolf has a %3$s%% chance to drop up to %4$s bones.
Each wolf bite applies bleeding level %5$s to the target for %6$s seconds.
For each killed target, has a %7$s%% chance to summon 1 additional wolf for %8$s seconds. The total number of such wolves cannot exceed %9$s.
relics.description.whirlisprig_petals.de: A light vortex of petals catches the relic bearer's movements, helping them sharply lift off the ground and maintain balance in the air.
relics.description.whirlisprig_petals.ab: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring each charge in %2$s seconds. Pressing RMB consumes 1 charge and launches the relic bearer %3$s blocks upward.
When the relic is held in hand, fully suppresses fall damage and grants the relic bearer's movements additional inertia.
Using the ability launches the relic bearer in the direction they are looking instead of the usual upward lift.
Each repeated use of the ability before landing accumulates 1 charge. Each charge increases the damage of the next attack by %4$s%%. All charges are reset on attack or landing.
+1 experience point for each second of active lift.
+1 experience point for each directed use of the petals.
+1 experience point for each attack empowered by accumulated charges.
